rationale.formal-methods: Design-by-contract specifications underpin testing, verification, and runtime checking.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Executable contracts and targeted tests deterministically detect behavioral violations.
rationale.ai-review: LLMs generate contract-grounded tests and use violations for iterative checking.
rationale.quality-debt: ATM demonstration exposes and corrects AI-generated logic and maintainability defects.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Task-contract-code traceability creates documentation supporting human review and audits.
rationale.framework: Four-stage contract-driven workflow is presented as a reusable QA architecture.
rationale.design-only: Illustrative manual example does not establish a working VibeContract implementation.
rationale.agentic: A single prompt produces a complete multi-class project for gate-level review.
rationale.steering: Validated contracts substantively constrain and guide subsequent code generation.
rationale.risk-quality: The contribution mitigates correctness, robustness, reliability, and maintainability harms.
